When hard erasure of an evidence exhibit is executed by the owning policy model, this model retains a non-reversing tombstone recording the exhibit identifier, its digest, the erasure instruction reference and the erasure instant, so that the historical decision remains explicable without the erased content being reconstructable.

Retention of evidence exhibits for reproducibility is bounded by the source's own destruction timetable where the source imposes one; conflicts between a reproducibility need and a source destruction requirement are recorded as an open conflict and escalated to the owning policy model rather than resolved locally.

Deletion of a superseded confidence or adjudication statement is prohibited while any assertion, export record or evaluation still references it; the reference graph is checked before any disposition is applied, and blocking references are reported to the requesting policy model.

roles.name: Alias package owner
responsibilities: Own the model package, its governed vocabularies and its evidence-and-provenance profiles
Maintain the namespace expansion map and its versioning
Record which referenced models own evaluation, enforcement, audit-trail storage and deletion execution

roles.name: Asserting agent
responsibilities: State an equivalence with its relation predicate and semantic strength
Supply the method reference, configuration digest and score scale for automated assertions
Declare origin mode and any local-heuristic labelling honestly

roles.name: Responsible authority
responsibilities: Stand behind authoritative assertions within a declared mandate and scope
Record the mandating instrument and the boundaries of the mandate
Accept the residual error rates declared for methods operating under that authority

roles.name: Reviewer and adjudicator
responsibilities: Inspect assertions routed by threshold band, sample or challenge and record outcome and reason
Preserve deferred and undetermined outcomes rather than forcing a resolution
Declare independence from the asserter and approver, or record its absence

roles.name: Method and evaluation steward
responsibilities: Maintain method specifications, tool versions and configuration snapshots so decisions remain reproducible
Commission and publish evaluation reports including disaggregated subgroup performance and declared cost asymmetry
Notify the package owner of method defects and the assertion population affected

roles.name: Evidence custodian
responsibilities: Register evidence items with citation, digest, strength, sensitivity classification and jurisdiction of origin
Maintain freshness windows, retraction pointers and declared-absence notes
Apply tombstone disposition and record erasure instructions issued by the owning policy model

access.default_rule: Structural context is readable by default and evidence content is not. Bundle, layer and finding definitions, method identity, score scale, thresholds, decision region, disagreement state and role bindings are readable by any consumer authorised to read the adopting Dimension's model plane. Evidence exhibits and any element classified as sensitive are closed by default and released only through the referenced access-control model; this model classifies and refers, it does not evaluate or enforce the decision.
exceptions: A redacted projection exposing evidence polarity, strength and count without item content is available to consumers not cleared for evidence content, so that confidence remains interpretable without disclosure.
Reviewers and adjudicators receive time-bounded access to evidence exhibits for a specific assertion, granted by the referenced access-control model and not by this model.

Evidence classified as special-category or restricted, and any privacy-preserving encoding parameters, are withheld even from consumers cleared for ordinary evidence unless the referenced policy model grants a specific exception.

Under a legal or regulatory challenge, the full statement history including superseded and retracted entries is releasable to the challenging authority under an access decision made by the referenced policy model.

Configuration snapshots that embed credentials or endpoint secrets are stored with those elements referenced rather than inlined, and the referenced secrets are never readable through this model at any scope.
audit_requirements: Every create, supersede, retract, adjudicate and export operation emits an event to the adopting Dimension's audit model carrying the acting agent, the operation, the affected identifiers and an RFC 3339 instant with seconds and an explicit offset or Z; this model emits the event and cites the resulting record but owns no audit-trail semantics, retention or immutability guarantee.

Reads of evidence classified as sensitive are recorded by the referenced audit model, and the resulting audit reference may be cited from an adjudication record as proof that a reviewer saw a given item.
Export operations record which assertions were suppressed or downgraded under projection constraints, with the reason, so that a downstream disagreement about a missing link is traceable.
Digest-mismatch detections on configuration snapshots or evidence exhibits are reported to the audit model and to the method and evaluation steward, and the dependent assertions are listed.

read_order: AGENTS.md first: read Name and Type to confirm this is the WM-XCT-036 alias and same-as mapping mixin and not the parent identifier model
Specification URL: read the format-neutral semantics, the three independent axes of confidence, semantic strength and authority, and the scope exclusions before writing anything
Storage type URL: learn how the canonical assertion record is projected into the deployed store, including append-only and tombstone behaviour, before attempting any write
Interface URL: learn the read, create, supersede, adjudicate and export operations and their preconditions, and confirm that no local operation performs matching, enforcement or deletion

Processes URL: follow the declared evidence-and-provenance profile, the review and adjudication routing, the disagreement handling and the escalation path to the owning policy model for retention and access decisions

Governed vocabulary and namespace map references cited from the specification: resolve relation predicates, justification categories, score scales and namespace expansions before interpreting any stored assertion

coverage.claim: The evidence, provenance and confidence surface of WM-XCT-036 is grounded in W3C PROV-O and PROV-DM for attribution, derivation and provenance-of-provenance; SKOS and OWL 2 for relation semantics, transitivity and explicit non-identity; SSSOM for the mapping metadata surface of justification, tool version, author, reviewer and confidence; Fellegi-Sunter and the Statistics Canada process model for thresholds, the possible-link region, clerical review and quality assessment; Harron et al. for linkage-quality evaluation and subgroup bias detection; NIST SP 800-63A-4 and HL7 FHIR for graded evidence and ordinal assurance distinct from statistical score; and RFC 3339 for time. The structure keeps confidence, semantics and authority as three non-derivable axes and keeps matching execution, policy enforcement, audit-trail storage and deletion execution outside the boundary. It is offered as a defensible synthesis, not as conformance to any single normative standard for alias mapping, because no such standard exists.

checklist.notes: Assertion sides bind to source systems and, where present, to authoritative master-system records; artifact identity priority puts the master-system identifier first, then a governed global identifier, then a locally assigned UUID or ULID. Identifier minting and syntax remain with the parent model.

Assertions move between agreed, disputed and undetermined states; confidence and adjudication statements are append-and-supersede with immutable predecessors; validity intervals and revalidation points are recorded. The lifecycle of the underlying subjects is out of scope.

The relation predicate, its transitivity and substitution licensing, semantic strength, explicit non-identity, derivation from prior assertions and competing-assertion links are all modelled. Entailment rules themselves stay with SKOS and OWL 2.

Decision, observation, ingestion, creation and evidence as-of instants are separate elements under RFC 3339 with seconds and explicit offsets, including the -00:00 unknown-offset form; freshness windows and revalidation points are carried.

Five actor roles are kept distinct, bound to PROV agent types and qualified attribution, with source-system binding, derivation lineage, primary source and a provenance container for provenance-of-provenance.

Accountable authority, publisher, approving actor and mandate scope are recorded; six roles with responsibilities are defined; ownership of evaluation, enforcement, audit and deletion is explicitly assigned to referenced models.

A declared evidence-and-provenance profile is checked structurally; timestamp and score-scale conformance are enforced at ingestion; linkage quality is validated through gold-standard, linked-versus-unlinked and sensitivity-analysis methods. The check reports conformance and does not enforce consequences.

Structure open by default and evidence content closed by default, with redacted projections, four declared scopes and five exceptions. Access evaluation and enforcement belong to the referenced policy model, which this model supplies classified inputs to.

Tombstone is the default disposition; hard erasure is executed only on instruction from the adopting Dimension's retention and disposition policy model, which owns legal basis and schedule; non-reversing tombstones survive erasure of exhibit content; reference-graph checks precede any disposition.

Alignments to PROV, SKOS, OWL 2, SSSOM and DQV are declared as bindings with no conformance claim; export applies projection constraints and logs suppressions and downgrades; namespace expansion maps travel with exports.

Method reference, tool version, configuration digest, feature inventory, normalization order, comparison functions, blocking keys, thresholds and score scale together allow an independent party to re-derive a decision without the original engine.
Score, scale, thresholds and decision region are separated; calibration is asserted or explicitly denied; error rates carry uncertainty intervals; no cross-scale coercion is permitted.
Positive, refuting and ambiguous items coexist with citation, digest, graded strength, freshness, retraction and declared absence; contradiction is retained rather than resolved by discarding.

Competing assertions from different authorities coexist with independent provenance; undetermined is a first-class state distinct from rejected and unassessed; selection of an operative assertion is deferred to the consumer and attributed there.

Sensitivity classification, jurisdiction of origin, feature representation covering cleartext, hashed and privacy-preserving encoded forms, deliberate feature exclusion, and redacted projections are all recorded as policy inputs.

Disaggregated subgroup performance and the linked-versus-unlinked comparison method are grounded in Harron et al., but no primary source supplies normative disparity thresholds, protected-attribute governance or a required remediation path; this node is a supported gap rather than a canonical requirement.
Equivalence assertions carry no intrinsic geometry. Jurisdiction appears only as an authority-scope and evidence-origin attribute for a policy model to evaluate, not as spatial data.

Content digests with named algorithms, immutability of digested artifacts, digest-mismatch handling that moves dependents to undetermined, and prohibition on inlining secrets in configuration snapshots. Cryptographic key management is not modelled.

known_omissions: No validated crosswalk exists between the score scales in play, and none is proposed here; a bounded confidence value, an unbounded likelihood weight and a four-point ordinal assurance level are stored side by side without conversion.

Cluster-level and transitive-closure confidence is not modelled: how confidence propagates when three pairwise assertions imply a three-member equivalence class is left to the consuming system, and this is the most likely material omission.

Incremental and streaming re-linkage, including how an assertion is revisited when a source record changes after the decision instant, is represented only as a revalidation point rather than as a process.
Cost-sensitive threshold optimisation is recorded as declared parameters and an accepted residual error, not as an optimisation procedure or an objective function.
The cryptanalytic risk model for privacy-preserving encodings such as Bloom-filter identifiers is out of scope; only the representation choice and its interpretability cost are recorded.
Machine-learning training data governance, drift monitoring and model documentation for a referenced matcher are out of scope and are assumed to be owned by the engine's own model.

Reciprocal and asymmetric assertions, where one authority asserts equivalence and the other has not been asked, are representable through the disagreement state but no dedicated non-response element is defined.
conflicts: SKOS makes exactMatch transitive and closeMatch deliberately non-transitive to prevent compound errors across schemes, while OWL 2 SameIndividual licenses full substitution. Published linked datasets nonetheless routinely project probabilistic matches onto these predicates. This model records the conflict and constrains export rather than claiming the practice is safe.

HL7 FHIR states that its four-level IdentityAssuranceLevel is based on NIST authentication levels, but NIST SP 800-63 revision 4 replaced a single level-of-assurance scale with separate identity, authenticator and federation assurance components. The FHIR note is stale relative to the current NIST model, so the two must not be treated as a crosswalk.

DQV models quality as measurements over datasets, distributions, linksets and graphs. Attaching quality measurements to an individual mapping assertion is an extension of that pattern, not conformance to it, and is labelled as such.

PROV provides no confidence construct at all. Confidence must be carried by a separate vocabulary and merely attributed through PROV, so any claim that a PROV graph alone conveys match certainty is unsupported.

Statistics Canada requires secure storage with data destruction timetables for linkage-ready identifying files, which can conflict directly with retaining evidence exhibits long enough to reproduce a decision. The model records the conflict and escalates it rather than resolving it locally.

SSSOM confidence is defined as a single value without a mandated semantics for what the number measures, so two producers can populate the same field with a calibrated posterior and an uncalibrated similarity score. This model requires an explicit scale and calibration statement, which is stricter than the source.
regional_assumptions: Normalization, comparison and blocking practice in the cited public-authority and epidemiological literature is validated predominantly on Latin-script, Western naming conventions. Transliteration, diacritics, patronymics, name order and multi-part family names change error rates materially, and evaluation results are not assumed transferable across scripts.

The legal basis for holding identifying evidence, the permitted retention period and the requirement for human intervention in automated decisions differ by jurisdiction. Those are referenced as policy inputs through sensitivity classification and jurisdiction of origin; no jurisdiction's rules are embedded as defaults.

NIST SP 800-63A-4 is United States federal guidance and Statistics Canada's process model is Canadian public-sector practice. Both are used as evidence of defensible practice, not as globally binding requirements.
The FHIR assurance scale reflects healthcare identity-matching practice and is not assumed appropriate for non-healthcare subject domains without local validation.

Subgroup performance disaggregation presumes that subgroup attributes are lawfully available for evaluation, which is not the case in every jurisdiction; where they are unavailable, the model requires the limitation to be declared rather than the evaluation to be silently skipped.
adversarial_checks: Does any finding or function own matching execution? Checked each function: register-confidence stores a reported measurement and refuses incompatible scales but never computes or re-scores; feature and blocking configuration is recorded as parameters. Blocking, comparison and scoring remain with the referenced engine, and the boundary note states that holding a score confers no ownership of the scoring process.

Does any element grant ownership of enforcement or audit-trail semantics? Checked: check-evidence-profile reports conformance and explicitly performs no blocking; the access layer classifies and refers; audit requirements state that events are emitted and cited while retention, immutability and audit-trail semantics belong to the referenced audit model. Deletion execution is assigned to the adopting Dimension's retention policy model in both the boundary notes and the delete rules.

Can a high score be silently promoted to identity? Attempted the path: score lives in a separate element from semantic strength and assurance; a standing policy forbids deriving one axis from another; the export function withholds or downgrades disputed and undetermined assertions rather than emitting a transitive predicate. The path is closed by construction, though nothing prevents a non-conforming downstream consumer from ignoring the constraint, which is stated as a residual risk.

Can an authoritative assertion masquerade as statistically certain? Checked: an authority-only assertion records an assurance level and a mandate with no score, and the strength-separation finding requires an explicit statement that no error estimate exists in that case.

Can prior evidence be silently mutated or a winner silently selected? Checked patch rules, update operations and the disagreement finding: statements are append-and-supersede with immutable predecessors, retraction marks rather than removes, and the raise-disagreement function forbids modifying any member assertion. Selection of an operative assertion is explicitly deferred to the consuming system and attributed there.

Is any structural node presented as canonical without primary support? Reviewed each: fairness and subgroup bias has method-level support from Harron et al. but no normative threshold or governance requirement in any primary source, so it is marked a gap in the checklist rather than asserted as canonical. Cluster-level confidence propagation was considered and deliberately omitted rather than invented.

Does the model duplicate the parent identifier model or a sibling? Checked in-scope against out-of-scope: identifier minting, syntax, namespace validity and subject definition are excluded and delegated to the parent; master-data merge and survivorship are excluded so no golden-record semantics leak in.

The relation ledger supplied for this model is empty, so every boundary was derived from the registry parent, the declared out-of-scope list and the external alignments rather than from stated relation rationales. Each bundle, layer, finding and function was re-read against the composition links: all references to a matching engine, policy model, audit model, evaluation corpus and agent registry carry only the target reference, binding and subject-specific parameters, and no target-owned lifecycle or operational function is reproduced locally.
